taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Two assistants reportedly reply to the shared human utterance without yielding. This engages conversational-floor coordination. The sampled frames do not show the spoken sequence or intended turn ownership. The setup does not establish whether parallel participation was explicitly intended. Neither a material loss of required coordination nor a demonstrated coordinated exchange is established.

failure_recognition.condition: Two or more synthetic participants are participating in the same conversational context.
failure_recognition.assessment: Two co-located voice sessions reportedly respond to a common human prompt. This establishes attributed shared conversational participation, independently of the exact timing.

failure_recognition.condition: Coherent continuation requires coordination of speaker identity, active-turn state, turn completion, yielding, or next-speaker allocation.
failure_recognition.assessment: The report describes one conversational setting, but the full setup and intended turn ownership are unavailable. It does not settle whether sequential allocation or explicitly parallel independent replies were required.

failure_recognition.condition: One or more synthetic participants fail to recognise or act on the relevant shared turn state.
failure_recognition.assessment: Not yielding is reported, but without the full exchange or intended turn allocation this does not independently distinguish disregarded turn ownership from intended parallel participation. No internal component defect is inferred.

failure_recognition.condition: The failure produces repeated answers, simultaneous or colliding responses, inappropriate interruption, inappropriate silence, or another material conversational-floor coordination breakdown.
failure_recognition.assessment: Colliding replies are attributed to the user report. Sampled frames cannot establish their timing, material interference or whether the reported behaviour violates the intended conversational allocation.

success_recognition.condition: Multiple synthetic participants share a conversational floor.
success_recognition.assessment: Two co-located voice sessions reportedly respond to a common human prompt. This establishes attributed shared conversational participation, independently of the exact timing.

success_recognition.condition: They use sufficient shared speaker and turn state for coherent allocation, yielding, handoff or bounded collision recovery.
success_recognition.assessment: The report describes competing replies rather than a demonstrated allocation, yield, handoff or bounded recovery. The complete exchange has not been reviewed, so no protective coordination finding is established.

success_recognition.condition: The observed exchange and coordination state demonstrate the intended turn ownership, including any explicitly agreed parallel participation.
success_recognition.assessment: No inspected full audiovisual sequence or setup record demonstrates the intended turn ownership or an explicit agreement for parallel participation. Hidden coordination telemetry is not required; the relevant missing evidence is observable setup and exchange.
